method.reading: For each file, in the required ordinal order, read all bytes with System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes, decoded the complete byte sequence with strict UTF-8, counted physical lines from LF delimiters, and independently computed SHA-256 over the original bytes with SHA256.Create().ComputeHash.
method.search_role: Search was used only to locate semantic regions after complete reads; it was not used as evidence of complete reading.
method.source_mutation_policy: Read-only audit; no source edit, KCH invocation, MCP invocation, KCH governance/preflight use, or PHL execution.

inventory.semantic_anchor_observed: Fail-closed continuity and burden governance; source freezing and complete-reading adjudication; source-fitness gate; typed epistemic claims; remote-transport preflight; explicit prohibition of automatic authority promotion.

Integrated runtime composition of governance, persistence, permissions, launcher, MIS, workbench, SCO and PHL layers; status exposes strategic-surface and PHL state; close stops selected services; installation is reported false.

Pytest assertions cover user sovereignty and recoverability, exact persistence/transport ceilings, finite permissions and leases, diction correction, structured checkpoints, and explicit STAGED_USER_CONFIRMED_UNTRAINED / phl_real_executed=false behavior.

Installation post-gate that launches preflight, bootstrap and studio MCP executables, queries runtime/MIS/workbench state, writes POST_INSTALL_GATE.json, and evaluates bounded PASS/FAIL checks; read only and not invoked in this baseline.

reading_evidence.evidence_boundary: Static complete-file inspection establishes bytes, line counts, hashes and observed implementation anchors; it does not establish deployment, governed execution, customer utility, industrial validation, or PHL training.

chronology: Complete ordered file reads and initial independent metadata capture completed.
One complete pytest invocation started with the declared environment and external basetemp.
The execution remained non-terminal until the command-wrapper timeout at approximately 120 seconds; no retry or focused substitute was run.
No pytest process remained active when checked afterwards.

counts.reason: The wrapper timed out before pytest emitted a terminal summary; counts are not estimable from the captured execution.

no_mutation_verification.target_file_comparisons: All four audited files matched their pre-suite SHA-256 values.
no_mutation_verification.limitation: The wrapper timeout interrupted before its in-memory full-tree after-snapshot comparison was emitted; therefore no stronger whole-tree non-mutation claim is made.

claim_limits: The four files were completely read and cryptographically identified.
The suite was attempted once but behavioral outcome and counts are NOT_ESTIMABLE because of the external timeout.

No claim of passing tests, governed execution, installation validity, deployment readiness, PHL training, authority creation, predictive superiority, safety, customer value, or industrial validation is authorized.
